title: Between the Ground and the Clouds
style: Narrative soft rock with brisk punk-leaning verses and a hip-hop bridge. Driving live kit and overdriven guitar stabs push the verses; open ringing guitars and broad melodic bass widen the chorus; bridge drops to a tight half-time kick, clipped bass, and conversational rhythmic male vocal, then builds back into full-band soft rock. Intimate, clear English lead vocal, restrained and reflective rather than theatrical; polished organic mix, strong dynamic contrast, memorable repeated chorus.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Teterboro, runway trembling under blue
Six hours sealed with Claire and Gabi in the cabin
I watched them size each other up, then looked away
Told myself the danger wasn’t in the air
I took the rear-facing seat for takeoff
Gabi beside me in the conference cubicle
When the plane leveled, Claire appeared
With a paper bag and a professional smile

[Pre-Chorus]
The trip was planned, the papers could have traveled
By courier, stamped and sent across the miles
But there were faces I had missed for too long
And a city calling me back for a while

[Chorus]
Somewhere between the ground and the clouds
I was measuring what I couldn’t say
Claire kept calm, Gabi looked out
And I kept moving the truth away
Bogotá waiting under a colder sky
My old life gathered at the other side
I knew the flight would end at dawn
I didn’t know what I’d be choosing by then

[Verse 2]
Fernando called the landing, Bogotá night
Gabi had one light jacket somewhere in her bag
I’d lent her mine; Pilar stood on the tarmac
Holding a spare like she’d read the scene ahead
At home, Gabi asked me straight if Claire and I
Had crossed that line before we left
I said yes; her German landed somewhere
Between “lucky” and “you fool”—or so I guessed

[Chorus]
Somewhere between the ground and the clouds
I was measuring what I couldn’t say
Claire kept calm, Gabi looked out
And I kept moving the truth away
Bogotá waiting under a colder sky
My old life gathered at the other side
I knew the flight would end at dawn
I didn’t know what I’d be choosing by then

[Verse 3]
She stayed in mostly, thin air stealing her plans
But Saturday she came to lunch with my parents
Lucía and the kids were there at the table
Gabi and Lucía talked for a long, long time
I didn’t ask what passed between them
The station works, the papers, all the stops
I saw my city, saw my family
Never checked the Western Spine at all

[Bridge — Hip-Hop]
Sunday, past eleven, wheels leave the ground
No crowd, no service, just the few of us around
Fernando, his copilot, Claire in her seat
Gabi went under first, quiet and deep
Then Claire turned close, with the cabin lights low:
“How serious are you about Gabi?”
I searched for a sentence, a promise, a sign—
Teterboro by six, still no answer in mind

[Final Chorus]
Somewhere between the ground and the clouds
I was measuring what I couldn’t say
Claire kept calm, Gabi looked out
And I kept moving the truth away
The runway came back beneath the morning sky
Two unanswered lives on either side
I knew the flight had brought us home
I still didn’t know where my heart belonged

[Outro]
I couldn’t answer
I couldn’t answer
